title: How Sunset scaled its customer success team with Contrario
summary: Sunset had been trying to fill a critical customer success role since January. The problem was not a shortage of candidates. It was finding ones good enough to hire, fast enough to matter.
body_markdown:
Sunset helps venture-backed startups wind down, handling the legal, tax, and operational work of shutting a company down so founders can move on to what's next. Founded by Brendan Mahony and Grant Rheingold, the company was scaling to keep pace with rising customer demand.


Vishnu Thyagarajan, Director of Customer Success at Sunset, owned the search for a customer success role that had sat open since January.
